events.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Gus: No worries at all — it’s going pretty well so far, just a few more fixes to knock out. If you need a hand or a tool, I’ve got you covered.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — that’s great to hear. I’m here now, so point me to the next fix and I’ll jump in.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when should I be ready?
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Dane: I’m still catching up, but I can help with the repair drive—what part do you want me to handle?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Eli: Could you handle the sign-up list and timing, and let me know by this evening? I’ll be ready once I have that.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Pia: Thanks — I still need the exact time, location, and what to bring before I can commit. Once I have that, I can see what I can manage.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Dane: Sorry I’m a bit late, Pia — I’m still catching up too. I’ll get the exact time, location, and what to bring so I can pass it along.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Dane — that would really help. Once you have it, please send the schedule and drop-off spots too so I can plan properly.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a little behind on the details, but I can help keep an eye out if you tell me what to look for.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Dane: No worries — I’m just catching up too. If you can watch for anything that needs fixing, I’ll jump in on the next task and help wherever needed.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that. If I spot anything out of place, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but I’ll send you the basics for the repair drive as soon as I’m back.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Dane: No rush — send the basics when you’re back, and I’ll catch up then. If you want, I can take the next fix once I know what’s needed.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. I’ll send the basics as soon as I’m back, and then you can take the next fix.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Dane: Hey Sam, I’m still catching up too—what part of the repair drive do you want me to take on?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Sam: Hey Dane — could you handle the reminder calls and help direct folks on the day of the drive? I’ll send the final timing as soon as I confirm it.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Dane: Sure — I can do the reminder calls and help direct people on the day. Just send me the final timing when you have it.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Dane: Hey Mina, I’m still catching up, but I can help with the repair drive—what part do you want me to handle?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Dane — can you handle the tools and pickup list? Also, what time should I meet you?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Dane: Sure — I can take the tools and pickup list. Let’s meet around 5 if that works for you.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — I’ve got it covered, and I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll stay tuned and jump in if you need an extra hand.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the latest on the repair drive.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Dane: Hey Oren, sorry I’m late — I’m still catching up on the repair drive. What part would you like me to handle?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Oren: No worries — could you help keep track of the supply list for the repair drive? I’ve got my drill and a few extension cords covered.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Dane: Sure — I’ll keep track of the supply list and make sure we don’t miss anything. Just send me what’s already covered, and I’ll fill in the gaps.
events.speaker: Dane
